Manage Scope displayed ('958 / 1000 prompts · 5 selected', banner '1 prompt is in Other.'). Prompts table: 31 rows, 5 kept. The only Other prompt is the custom 'Which electric bike brands are best for commuting in London?' (GB (EN), kept, tinted bg-amber-50), Other on BOTH dimensions: Category cell = inline select (combobox 'Category') reading 'Other', Type cell = inline select (combobox 'Type') reading 'Other'. Both inline selects are verified, but on a single Other/Other prompt; the CSV needs one prompt Other on type only (in C1) and one Other on category only (Visibility). Proposed CSV change: allow the precondition 'one custom prompt Other on both dimensions' as an alternative, or provide a dedicated UA with the two single-dimension prompts.

results.notes: Data adaptation: UA = 'Electric bikes' 42c3ab89-7dfd-4ba5-b5ec-117cec2514e4 (C1 = 'Commuter Electric Bikes', GB (EN) only). Given: Manage Scope > Prompts, ring '958 / 1000 prompts · 5 selected' (X = 958, P = 1000). When: Add prompt > 'What do people say about Sunday deliveries?' Category 'Commuter Electric Bikes', Type left empty (draft reads 'Other'), GB (EN) > 'Add this prompt' = immediate save, blocked by the read-only guard: POST https://staging-geo.onclusive.com/geo/api/v1/reports/42c3ab89-7dfd-4ba5-b5ec-117cec2514e4/prompts payload {"marketId":"99920ac1-f110-4b0a-926c-3c1f188ac17d","categoryId":"d8330c1b-c192-4259-977c-0abd12590c37","questionType":"OTHER","questionText":"What do people say about Sunday deliveries?"} (sent twice, both aborted). UI: toast 'Failed to update the prompt. Please try again.', ring unchanged '958 / 1000 · 5 selected'; the draft was cancelled. The payload confirms the empty type is sent as questionType OTHER. The 'X + 1 / P' ring, the next collection and the C1 Other tab cannot be checked without saving. Reference only (not the CSV prompt): on the dashboard category 'Other' page, the existing Other/Other prompt 'Which electric bike brands are best for commuting in London?' is listed under the 'Other 1' tab with Winner / Themes = theme chips 'folding capabilities', 'commuting suitability', '+2' and no winner; its detail panel shows SENTIMENT, THEMES and RESPONSE, and no 'keyword' text anywhere on the page - consistent with 'key concepts only'. Proposed CSV change: keep as a manual TC run on a dedicated analysis where saving is allowed (it needs a save + a completed collection).
